title: OneLLM: One Framework to Align All Modalities with Language
layout_note: Five modality inputs and their tokenizers are stacked in a column at the left; all five arrows enter one tall Universal Encoder bar; a column of tokens leads into a large grey Universal Projection Module panel (three projection experts plus a router), and the projected tokens enter a tall Large Language Model bar at the right.
grouping: The projection experts, router, routing-weight plot and combination node sit inside one large light-grey panel titled Universal Projection Module; token columns sit on light-grey strips; a one-line legend for frozen, trainable, concat and drop token runs along the top.
shapes_depth: Flat rectangles: light-blue rounded tokenizer boxes, tall light-grey Universal Encoder bar with vertical text, salmon Projection Expert boxes, a green Modality Router box, a tall light-blue LLM bar with vertical text. Tokens are square cells in vertical columns (salmon modality tokens q_m, blue features x_m). A small green bar chart shows routing weights; a circled cross combines the experts. Curly fans split one arrow to three experts and gather them back. Snowflake and flame icons mark frozen/trainable.
proposed_highlight: The Universal Projection Module, the contribution, is the largest panel and the only one holding coloured parts (salmon experts, green router, routing-weight plot); the Universal Encoder is drawn as one tall bar shared by all tokenizers.
lesson: Make sharing visible as geometry: one tall encoder bar spanning exactly the stacked rows of per-modality tokenizers, so 'one encoder for every modality' reads before any label.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv PDF states no venue; remembered venue CVPR 2024 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. 'Eq. (1)' and 'Eq. (2)' appear only as labels pointing at the combination node and the routing weights; no formula is typeset. Input thumbnails (photo, waveform, point cloud, IMU traces, head outline) are embedded images (photo_share).

arrangement.units: one left-to-right composition; only the Universal Projection Module is enclosed (large light-grey panel); token columns on narrow grey strips
arrangement.inputs_as: a column of thumbnails: a real photo of a puppy and kitten, a coloured audio waveform, a grey point-cloud car, coloured IMU traces, a line drawing of a head with a brain
arrangement.shared: the Universal Encoder is one tall bar receiving arrows from all five tokenizers

taxonomy.task: aligning eight modalities to an LLM through per-modality tokenizers, one shared frozen encoder and a routed mixture of projection experts

insights.structure: Per-modality parts (inputs, tokenizers) are a stacked column at the left; everything after is one shared path: a tall encoder bar, a projection panel and a tall LLM bar.
insights.data: Each modality is drawn as its own kind of thumbnail, intermediate features are vertical columns of token cells, and routing weights are a small bar chart beside the router.
insights.emphasis: The projection module is the largest panel and carries the figure's only saturated fills (salmon experts, green router).
insights.flow: Straight horizontal arrows left to right; one arrow forks by a curly fan into three experts and gathers back into a circled-cross node, which the router's weights reach by an upward arrow.
insights.avoid: Salmon is used both for the learnable modality tokens and for the projection experts, and the flame/snowflake pair on the projection module and the LLM leaves frozen vs trainable ambiguous.

core.what: one tall Universal Encoder bar spans the five stacked modality tokenizers, all of whose arrows enter it

relations.form: a single tall grey encoder bar spanning the column of five tokenizer boxes, one arrow from each
the modality-token pair q_m enters from a top-left strip via a line labelled 'select & concatenate' and stacks above the feature column x_m with a '+'
three identical salmon Projection Expert boxes stacked inside the projection panel, fanned from one arrow and gathered into one circled-cross node
the Modality Router's routing-weight bar chart sends an upward arrow into the circled-cross node where the experts' outputs combine
one left-to-right axis: inputs, tokenizers, Universal Encoder, token column, projection module, projected tokens, LLM, 'Response'

channels.colour: light blue = per-modality tokenizers and the LLM bar and also the x_m feature tokens; salmon = learnable modality tokens and also the projection experts (two meanings); green = the router and its routing weights; light grey = shared encoder and panel/strip backgrounds
channels.shape: rounded boxes = modules, tall bars with vertical text = shared encoder and LLM, square cells = tokens, bar chart = routing weights, circled cross = weighted combination, thumbnails = inputs
channels.line: black arrows = data flow; a grey curved arrow at the bottom = dropped tokens (keyed 'drop token'); curly fans = split to and gather from experts
channels.frame: the large grey panel = the Universal Projection Module unit

quality.strengths: Sharing is geometry (one tall encoder bar spanning all tokenizer rows); the contribution is the largest panel; the token columns q_m and x_m and the routing weights are drawn as data between their makers and the combination node; arrows are short, straight and horizontal on one axis; a top legend keys icons.
quality.weaknesses: Salmon marks both modality tokens and experts and light blue marks both tokenizers and features; the projection module and LLM carry a combined flame/snowflake mark that does not say which part is trained when; the 'select & concatenate' line runs across the top over the encoder from a strip far to the left; the dropped-token arrow is a faint curve below the panel.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
